skipSemantics: May-skip, not must-skip: a listed test that runs and passes on a machine where its precondition holds is green. Matching is exact on the pre-'(' portion of the TRX result testName (xunit theory rows serialize with arguments, e.g. Class.Method(x: 1)); a name with no parens matches whole. Anchor is the TRX result list, never Counters arithmetic.
admissionRule: allowedSkips is not a quarantine list. A test may be listed only when its precondition is a property of the machine or OS that cannot be satisfied by configuration during a contract run, and its change names the machine class where it executes. Two named PERMANENT BANS apply: (1) CcpClient.Tests.DataRootOverrideTests.DefaultSettingsPath_EnvUnset_IsThePlatformDefault must never be allowed to skip because a process-wide CCP_DATA_ROOT override makes the floor vacuous; (2) CcpClient.Tests.ChaosTunnelLoopbackTests.Logging_RouteClassesOnly_NeverFilenameOrQuery must be fixed at the source, never quarantined.
bumpRule: Bump total only in the same commit as the test change that moves the count, with the reason recorded here. Never widen, disable, or special-case a check to make a step pass. Adding a name to allowedSkips requires the admission rule above and the machine class where it executes.
lastMovedBy: Merged the camera capability seam - the FIRST slice of the webcam-gaze row, and deliberately NOT the engine. +16 unit, 0 headless. It builds the typed camera capability and its consent seam so that every later slice's refusal is truthful; no camera is opened, no frame decoded, no model loaded, and AdmittedEngines is EMPTY, so every product run reports Unavailable(camera-no-engine). THE PRIVACY GATE IS THE POINT AND IT IS PROVED: ProbeAsync asks the engine gate and the consent gate BEFORE it can reach ICameraDeviceSource.Enumerate, and the fact RestoringSettingsAndGrantingConsentBothAskNOTHINGOfAnyCamera counts every ask across a whole launch - start, probe, GRANT CONSENT, probe again - and holds the count at zero, because the engine rung is asked first. It names its own inversion: move the consent rung above the engine rung and the third block fails. That is capability-inventory.md's 'opening the dashboard, restoring settings, or finding calibration never starts it' turned into something that can fail. Both platform routes exist rather than a Windows path plus a silent absence: DirectShow on Windows, V4L2/sysfs on Linux, with the XDG portal branch a TYPED REFUSAL naming the portal rather than a pretend client. Linux identity is honestly UNSTABLE - no durable id exists without udev or an open(2) - so IdentityIsStable is false there and this slice persists no camera identity at all, rather than inventing one the contract would then have to trust. CcpClient.Tests 2700 to 2716, CcpClient.HeadlessTests unchanged at 155.
